title: Name tag
prompt:
Print a name tag from two initials and an age read from input. For the input `A B 19` the tag reads:

```
HELLO my name is
A.B. (age 19)
```

The starter reads the input and leaves the first initial in `first_r`, the second in `last_r`, and the age in `age_r`. Add one format string to `.data` and print the whole tag with a single `printf`.

Each format specifier takes the next argument register in order: the first reads `w1`, the second `w2`, the third `w3`. `%c` prints the character whose code is in the register, and `%d` prints a 32-bit signed whole number, so `w` registers are the right width for all three. A `\n` in the middle of the format string starts the second line.

## what is checked

- with input `A B 19` the output is exactly the two lines above
- the program exits cleanly
- the program also runs on inputs you do not see, so it has to work for any input, not only this one
starter:
// print a name tag from two initials and an age read from input
define(fp, x29)
define(lr, x30)

define(first_r, w19)
define(last_r, w20)
define(age_r, w21)

.data
fmt_in:     .string " %c %c %d"

.bss
first_in:   .skip 1                         // scanf stores one character here
last_in:    .skip 1                         // and one here
        .balign 4
age_in:     .skip 4                         // and the age here

.text
        .balign 4
        .global main
main:
        stp     fp, lr, [sp, -16]!
        mov     fp, sp

        ldr     x0, =fmt_in                 // read the initials and the age
        ldr     x1, =first_in
        ldr     x2, =last_in
        ldr     x3, =age_in
        bl      scanf

        ldr     x9, =first_in               // bring all three into registers
        ldrb    first_r, [x9]
        ldr     x9, =last_in
        ldrb    last_r, [x9]
        ldr     x9, =age_in
        ldr     age_r, [x9]

        // TODO: add a format string to .data, then print the whole tag
        // with one printf: the initials and the age go in w1, w2 and w3

        mov     w0, 0
        ldp     fp, lr, [sp], 16
        ret
